summary: You were on call and it ate everything. The pager kept going off overnight for the same disk space alert on the logging boxes, and you finally dug into why instead of clearing it again: the log rotation config never got copied over when you moved hosts. You wrote it all down in the on-call notes and paired with Priya on her search indexing question.
transcript: Catching up on the last few days because I didn't record anything.  "'I was on call, and it just ate everything.'  Nothing major broke, but the pager kept going off overnight for the same disk space alert on the logging boxes, and I finally dug into why instead of just clearing it again.  Turns out the log rotation config never got copied over when we moved hosts. I wrote it  all down in the on-call notes so the next person doesn't have to go through the same  I also paired with Priya for a bit on her search indexing question, which was a nice break from staring at dashboards.
takeaways: The log rotation config was missing because it never got copied over when you moved hosts.
You wrote the fix down in the on-call notes so the next person doesn't have to go through the same.
